title: Feature request: Widget for round smartwatch
body: A new Android widget for round smartwatches. With large numbers and arrows and the ability to stop alarms easily without having to access the menu. I use my watch as a master and it is very complicated to change application options with such small letters.

comments.body:
Among other problems, this is a major one for me too.
Try the app "accessibility suite" , provides magnification on smartwatch screen. Works very good.
